title: 请求用语 Can I…?
unitTitle: Module 5 Can I have an ice cream? 请求与许可

questions.question: 「我可以吃个冰淇淋吗？」的英文是（　）
options: Can I have an ice cream?
Can I has an ice cream?
Can I have a ice cream?
I can have an ice cream?
questions.answer: Can I have an ice cream?

questions.question: 肯定回答别人的请求，应说（　）
Can I come in? 是在请求许可。

knowledge.core_concept: 请求许可用 Can I…?，肯定 Yes, you can. / Yes, here you are. 否定 No, you can't. But you can have a cake.
knowledge.key_formula: Can I have an ice cream? — Yes, here you are.
common_mistakes: 请求时用 Give me…（不礼貌）。
knowledge.tips: 礼貌请求带 please 更好。
